label: 小红书 聚光 / 蒲公英 Xiaohongshu Ads
terms_note: '第一步注册成为开发者，注册流程由小红书销售内部发起审批，注册完成后将提供对应的授权信息；第二步拿到授权信息后可完成线上授权后，启动接口调用' (third-party summaries of the official whitepaper). Rate limits: unknown. Free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (developer credentials issued after sales-initiated approval → advertiser online authorization → token)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (聚光 Marketing API on the 小红书商业开放平台).
auth: 1. Developer registration initiated and approved internally by Xiaohongshu sales; authorization credentials issued.
2. Advertiser completes online authorization (OAuth) → access token.
3. Call 账户服务 / 投放管理 / 数据报表 / 素材管理 interfaces.

endpoints.call: 投放管理: 推广计划 / 单元 / 创意 batch create + query
endpoints.purpose: campaigns, ad groups, ads, budgets & bids

endpoints.call: 数据报表 (account / campaign / unit / creative by day)

reference.limits: - Rate limits unknown; access by sales-initiated approval; free API; 小红书 advertising qualification review.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: app_id of the 小红书开放平台 聚光 (MAPI) application (应用中心 > 编辑应用).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: secret of that application (应用中心 > 编辑应用); sent as `secret` in the refresh call.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: refresh_token from 获取token (auth_code exchange after the advertiser authorised the app's url). Valid 30 days and replaced on every refresh ('刷新后会生成新的 token，老的 access_token 和 refresh_token 将不可再使用'); set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the newest one survives restarts.

config_fields.name: advertiser_id
config_fields.help: 聚光 广告主ID (advertiser_id; returned as approval_advertisers with the token); used by the probe, update_budget and pause_resume.

adapter.terms: 小红书开放平台 聚光 Marketing API (MAPI, https://ad-market.xiaohongshu.com/docs-center?bizType=943&articleId=4437): JSON POST calls to https://adapi.xiaohongshu.com/api/open/jg/… with an Access-Token header (valid 1 day, 'Token有效期&续期' https://ad-market.xiaohongshu.com/docs-center?bizType=943&articleId=2607); refresh with POST /api/open/oauth2/refresh_token {app_id, secret, refresh_token}, which rotates the refresh token. Answers {code (0 = 成功), success, msg, data}. Requires an approved 开放平台 developer app (聚光 qualification + first top-up) and advertiser authorisation. 蒲公英 (creator marketplace) calls are not mapped.

me.note: No profile call exists for 聚光 MAPI; the probe lists one campaign of the configured advertiser (POST /api/open/jg/campaign/list, page_size 1).

list_campaigns.note: 查询计划 (POST /api/open/jg/campaign/list {advertiser_id, page {page_index, page_size ≤ 100}}): campaign_id, campaign_name, campaign_filter_state (1 有效, 2 暂停, 3 已删除, 4 计划预算不足, 5 现金余额不足 …), limit_day_budget, campaign_day_budget, marketing_target, placement, start_time, expire_time (numeric codes and the budget stay in raw). status is not sent (it is a numeric code).

get_report.note: 标准投计划层级离线报表 (POST /api/open/jg/data/report/offline/campaign, time_unit DAY, first 500 rows): per campaign and day fee (消耗, 元), impression, click, interaction and conversion metrics as strings; data.aggregation_data has the totals. Offline data is ready from 10:00 the next day. campaign_id is not applied (filter rows by campaign_id).

update_budget.note: 编辑计划 (POST /api/open/jg/campaign/update {advertiser_id, campaign_id, limit_day_budget: 1 指定预算, campaign_day_budget}) for the configured advertiser_id; daily_budget in 元 is sent in 分 (×100), the unit the MAPI uses for budgets (起量预算 '单位：分'; the campaign list sample shows campaign_day_budget 10000). Since 2026-09-01 this call no longer edits 产品种草 and 客资收集 campaigns ('停止支持…计划编辑'). This spends money; currency is ignored (CNY).

pause_resume.note: 修改计划状态 (POST /api/open/jg/campaign/status/update {advertiser_id, campaign_ids, action_type}) with pause → 2 (暂停) and resume → 1 (开启); 3 (删除) is never sent. data.campaign_ids lists the campaigns actually changed. Resuming restarts spend.

not_offered.list_accounts: 聚光 MAPI has no advertiser-listing call for brand developers: the authorised advertisers come back only inside the token response (data.approval_advertisers, https://ad-market.xiaohongshu.com/docs-center?bizType=943&articleId=4808), and 获取代理商子账号列表 is limited to agency developers (账户服务 category).

evidence: host adapi.xiaohongshu.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.2 (DNSPod, Inc.)
probe: 4/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check: the docs pages did not render (login wall, SPA or bot wall)
auth_audit.notes: adapi.xiaohongshu.com was intermittent from both audit hosts (TLS timeouts); when it answered, every tool got code 410019 access_token错误 on its path. no answer (timeout/connection) for list_campaigns
